name: Sukozawa Michiru
source:
The producer for "The Wandering Angels."

She oversees [url=/c93383]Shinnosuke Oarai[/url]'s interview with [url=/c73543]Minorikawa[/url], ensuring to keep the director on schedule.
Early in the morning, Sukozawa sent her assistant [url=/c129987]Yukio Tozuka[/url] to retrieve the actor Akiomi Mondo from his apartment. [spoiler]That evening, following their performance of [I]Au Revoir[/I], Sukozawa assigned Tozuka, [url=/c129988]Takuya Amo[/url], and [url=/c129986]Shin'ichi Bando[/url] to return the defective dry ice machine.[/spoiler]

(Portrayed by [url=/s13579]Kuwabara Yuuko[/url], the scenario writer of a "Wandering Angels" storyline draft cut during development. The draft served as the basis of the 6-episode "The Tale of the Wandering Angels" TIPS storyline within the game, and was later reimplemented into the novel adaptation of [I]428[/I].)
